description: This file defines TypeScript types related to the browser server context, including runtime state, profile state, server configuration, and actions for managing browser profiles and tabs in a server environment.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures the browser is available, returning a promise that resolves when the browser is ready.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures a tab is available, optionally targeting a specific tab by its ID.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP endpoint of the browser is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks general reachability of the browser, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Returns a list of currently open tabs in the browser.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new tab with the specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Brings focus to the tab with the specified target ID.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes the tab with the given target ID.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the browser profile, moving its data if necessary.

methods.name: mapTabError
methods.description: Converts an error into a standardized status message.
